ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent Medicaid fraud investigation in Minnesota, including the Trump administration's $243M Medicaid pause.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How does the Trump administration's $243M Medicaid pause affect the state's healthcare system?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme, and could lead to further investigations and reforms in the healthcare system.
